name: Create one or more shared environment variables
description: Create one or more shared environment variables Creates shared environment variable(s) for a team. POST /v1/env
context:
POST /v1/env
Creates shared environment variable(s) for a team.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Delete one or more Env Var
description: Delete one or more Env Var Deletes one or many Shared Environment Variables for a given team. DELETE /v1/env
context:
DELETE /v1/env
Deletes one or many Shared Environment Variables for a given team.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Retrieve the decrypted value of a Shared Environment Variable by id.
description: Retrieve the decrypted value of a Shared Environment Variable by id. GET /v1/env/{id}
context:
GET /v1/env/{id}
Retrieve the decrypted value of a Shared Environment Variable by id.
Required: id (path) — The unique ID for the Shared Environment Variable to get the decrypted value.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Lists all Shared Environment Variables for a team
description: Lists all Shared Environment Variables for a team Lists all Shared Environment Variables for a team, taking into account optional filters. GET /v1/env
context:
GET /v1/env
Lists all Shared Environment Variables for a team, taking into account optional filters.
Optional: search (query); projectId (query) — Filter SharedEnvVariables that belong to a project; ids (query) — Filter SharedEnvVariables based on comma separated ids; exclude_ids (query) — Filter SharedEnvVariables based on comma separated ids; exclude-ids (query) — Filter SharedEnvVariables based on comma separated ids; exclude_projectId (query) — Filter SharedEnvVariables that belong to a project; exclude-projectId (query) — Filter SharedEnvVariables that belong to a project; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Disconnects a shared environment variable for a given project
description: Disconnects a shared environment variable for a given project PATCH /v1/env/{id}/unlink/{projectId}
context:
PATCH /v1/env/{id}/unlink/{projectId}
Disconnects a shared environment variable for a given project
Required: id (path) — The unique ID for the Shared Environment Variable to unlink from the project.; projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Updates one or more shared environment variables
description: Updates one or more shared environment variables Updates a given Shared Environment Variable for a Team. PATCH /v1/env
context:
PATCH /v1/env
Updates a given Shared Environment Variable for a Team.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
